name: Nyūzen (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nyūzen town emblem in maroon: an outlined square with a diagonal band and a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Nyūzen, a town in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1960.

features.role: Nyūzen town emblem — an outlined square with a diagonal band and a stylised character
